2026-01-20.title: The code goes public
2026-01-20.story: X posts the For You feed code for anyone to read. An AI built on Grok ranks every post.

2026-05-15.title: Expansion pack
2026-05-15.story: Adds how ads get placed, spam detectors, and a mini model anyone can run at home.

2026-08-13.title: The mega drop
2026-08-13.story: 2,053 files at once. The real scoring weights, the safety filters, and the actual training code.

2026-08-14.title: Brazil election filter
2026-08-14.story: Accounts reported to Brazil's Electoral Court vanish from For You, unless you follow them.

2026-08-17.title: Spam radar tune-up
2026-08-17.story: Spam and rule-breaking detectors get retrained. New ad safety check added, switched off.

2026-08-18.title: Your follows get checked too
2026-08-18.story: Posts from people you follow now run their own safety check. Reply spam detector updated.

2026-08-19.title: Muted words hit harder
2026-08-19.story: Muted words now also catch text inside quoted posts.

2026-08-20.title: AI trend switch
2026-08-20.story: A new switch lets trend feedback shape ranking. Off by default.

2026-08-21.title: Model plumbing
2026-08-21.story: Storage and data changes inside the AI. Nothing you would notice.

2026-08-24.title: Safety tests added
2026-08-24.story: The safety filter gets a checker that compares old and new answers.

2026-08-25.title: Looking now counts
2026-08-25.story: Stopping to look at a post now earns points. Video views stop counting, video opens go up.

2026-08-26.title: Training upgrades
2026-08-26.story: Behind-the-scenes work on how the AI learns.

2026-08-28.title: Smarter ad placement
2026-08-28.story: A new ad mixer that checks how risky nearby posts are before placing an ad.

2026-09-01.title: New ad mixer goes live
2026-09-01.story: The risk-aware ad mixer becomes the default. Safety rules get reorganized.

2026-09-02.title: Stranger posts: long looks win
2026-09-02.story: The AI that finds posts from people you don't follow now learns from long looks too.

2026-09-03.title: A stranger's fix got in
2026-09-03.story: The first outside code fix gets merged. It stops duplicate safety lookups.

2026-09-04.title: Small account boost rewritten
2026-09-04.story: The code that helps small accounts get seen gets rebuilt from scratch.

2026-09-08.title: New AI picks stranger posts
2026-09-08.story: A new model starts picking posts from people you don't follow.

2026-09-09.title: Safety filter cleanup
2026-09-09.story: The final safety check before your feed gets simpler and faster.

2026-09-10.title: Safety plumbing
2026-09-10.story: Under the Hood reports and safety data get faster.

2026-09-12.title: Brazil list updated
2026-09-12.story: The list of election accounts gets updated.

2026-09-15.title: Feed variety tracker
2026-09-15.story: X starts measuring how varied each feed is.

2026-09-16.title: Ad safety check paused
2026-09-16.story: The newer ad safety check gets switched back off.

2026-09-17.title: The viral holdout
2026-09-17.story: A new switch can hide very liked posts from a small slice of people, up to 15%. Off by default.

2026-09-18.title: See legal takedowns
2026-09-18.story: Under the Hood now shows if a country forced your post to be hidden, and which one.

2026-09-22.title: Ranking gets logged
2026-09-22.story: More data recorded about which posts were picked and why.

2026-09-23.title: Final shuffle goes public
2026-09-23.story: X shares the code that does the last reshuffle of your feed. Small accounts get their own lane.

2026-09-24.title: Scoring moves house
2026-09-24.story: The scoring math moves into its own file. Same math, new home.

2026-09-25.title: Safety engine rebuild
2026-09-25.story: The visibility filter gets rebuilt. It can now tell which region you are in.

2026-09-26.title: Appeals stick
2026-09-26.story: If you win an appeal, the same punishment is not put back for a while.

2026-09-29.title: Clickbait loses points
2026-09-29.story: Just tapping in is worth less. Actually staying to read is worth way more. Not interested hurts more.

2026-09-30.title: Small account boost overhaul
2026-09-30.story: Accounts up to 50K followers now get a boost, but only for a post's first 2 hours.

2026-10-01.title: Limits explained
2026-10-01.story: New text explains why some actions are limited on your account.

2026-10-02.title: New way to find posts
2026-10-02.story: A new way to find posts by what they mean. Built, but off for now.

2026-10-03.title: Popular posts built
2026-10-03.story: A shared list of popular posts gets built. Ad safety check comes back on.

2026-10-06.title: Notices instead of deletes
2026-10-06.story: Safety can now keep a post up with a notice on it instead of hiding it.

2026-10-07.title: Popular posts go live
2026-10-07.story: Popular recent posts from the most followed accounts now join everyone's feed pool.

2026-10-08.title: Video row arrives
2026-10-08.story: A swipeable row of videos at spot 6 in your feed, at most once an hour. Testing.

2026-10-09.title: Faster training
2026-10-09.story: The AI trains faster. Nothing you would notice yet.

2026-10-13.title: Likes get a boost
2026-10-13.story: Likes are worth more, video opens worth way less. Brazil list cut to the runoff.

2026-10-14.title: Likes boosted again
2026-10-14.story: Second like boost in two days. Not interested hurts a post even more.

2026-10-15.title: Video row gets a brain
2026-10-15.story: The video row gets its own scoring AI. Ads now skip risky authors by default.

2026-10-16.title: Video row spots lookalikes
2026-10-16.story: A new check can catch near identical videos in the video row. Off by default for now.

2026-10-17.title: Fewer repeats in videos
2026-10-17.story: The video row now skips repeat creators and lookalike clips. It hides when follow suggestions show.

2026-10-20.title: No double videos
2026-10-20.story: The video row now skips clips already in your main feed. A topic history tracker was added, off by default.

2026-10-21.title: Fair share for sources
2026-10-21.story: A new rule would give each post source a fair slice of the feed shortlist. Off by default for now.

2026-10-22.title: Fair share goes live
2026-10-22.story: Every post source now gets a fair slice of your feed shortlist. Reactions to private or graphic posts get hidden or blurred.
extra: Reactions to adult or gore media

2026-10-23.title: Searches could shape feed
2026-10-23.story: X wired in your recent searches as a possible feed signal, off by default. Rule breaking posts kept for public interest get a label.

2026-10-24.title: Ads tracing switched on
2026-10-24.story: X turned on tracing for how ads reach your feed. The ad model also learns from purchases made days after seeing an ad.

2026-10-27.title: Per person score tuning
2026-10-27.story: X built a way to adjust predicted reactions to each person's own habits. It is off by default for now.

2026-10-28.title: Brazil election filter removed
2026-10-28.story: With Brazil's election over, X removed the filter that hid posts from flagged accounts. A whole feed reranker was added, off by default.

2026-10-29.title: Two new ad placers
2026-10-29.story: X built two new ways to place ads that keep them away from risky posts. A new video row score is set to 0 for now.
extra: Video row open plus watch time score

2026-10-30.title: Permanent bans get labels
2026-10-30.story: X's spam enforcer can now mark a suspension as permanent and tag why. The video row got a new score, set to 0.
extra: Video row uses main feed score

2026-10-31.title: Video row drops risky posts
2026-10-31.story: The swipe video row now skips posts flagged high risk. Ads switched to a new placer that spreads them out.
extra: High risk filter on video row
Report shows which posts got labels
Ads learn from late link clicks
